concept.title: Daytime activities and day care for someone with dementia
concept.shortdesc: As the main carer of someone with Alzheimer's, I need somewhere he can go during the day once or twice a week, so that I can rest.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-010). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Who: carers of people with dementia, people with dementia.
Situation: Exhausted, a spare half hour on a Sunday evening; her GP mentioned day services.
A good result: Day services that take people with dementia, with days, cost, whether an assessment is needed and how to arrange transport.
How much it matters: Important: a miss leaves someone without help they need.

ul.li: My husband has Alzheimer's and I need to find somewhere he could go during the day, even just once or twice a week, so I can rest. We're in Bristol, Bishopston area.
